analysis.headline: Microsoft posts record Q1 revenue driven by cloud growth
analysis.summary: Microsoft reported $92.3 billion in first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue, up 19 percent year over year, marking a tenth consecutive quarter of record revenue. Net income rose to $33.6 billion. Microsoft also disclosed it earned $10 billion from commercial arrangements with OpenAI and, for the first time, Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion.
